title: Toronto café idea of borrowing other people's brain power

tellings.quote: it's like 2018. I'm chilling in a cafe in Toronto and I look around, right?

plain: A researcher named Deep Prasad says that in 2018 he was sitting in a café in Toronto, looked around at the people near him, and came up with the idea of borrowing other people's brain power. He tells it on Jesse Michels's podcast, in an episode about the claim that artificial intelligence is alien technology, as the moment his thinking began.
